title: Robust Fairness Vision-Language Learning for Medical Image Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance fairness (using metrics like Group-wise AUC, Equity-Scaled AUC, Demographic Parity Difference, and Equalized Odds) for glaucoma diagnosis across different racial groups (Asian, Black, White) using the Harvard-FairVLMed dataset.

Evaluating model performance fairness (using metrics like Group-wise AUC, Equity-Scaled AUC, Demographic Parity Difference, and Equalized Odds) for glaucoma diagnosis across Female and Male patient groups using the Harvard-FairVLMed dataset.

Evaluating model performance fairness (using metrics like Group-wise AUC, Equity-Scaled AUC, Demographic Parity Difference, and Equalized Odds) for glaucoma diagnosis across Hispanic and Non-Hispanic patient groups using the Harvard-FairVLMed dataset.

Evaluating model performance fairness (using metrics like Group-wise AUC, Equity-Scaled AUC, Demographic Parity Difference, and Equalized Odds) for glaucoma diagnosis based on patients' preferred language (English, Spanish, Other) using the Harvard-FairVLMed dataset.
